## SINGLE PROTEIN

## TRIPLE BENEFITS

###  

**Single Animal Protein, Premium Fresh Nutrition**

###  

Introducing Hill's Science Diet Single Protein, fresh from the fridge to support your adult dog's
healthy digestion, radiant coat and overall health.

 

This great tasting premium fresh nutrition is gently steam-cooked and scientifically formulated to
support a long healthy life. It can be served as a delicious topper or a complete and balanced meal.

 

[Learn More][208]
[woman cutting Hill's Fresh product]
The Benefits
of a science-led diet
For Lean Muscles

We use only high-quality protein sources in our foods since they are the essential building blocks
of all tissues and organs of the body.

For a shiny coat

Fatty acids in many of our food formulas have important roles in immune system functions and help
protect the skin and coat.

For strong bones

 A balanced selection of vitamins and minerals keeps joints lubricated and helps pets build strong
bones and teeth.

## SINGLE PROTEIN

## TRIPLE BENEFITS

###  

**Single Animal Protein, Premium Fresh Nutrition**

###  

Introducing Hill's Science Diet Single Protein, fresh from the fridge to support your adult dog's
healthy digestion, radiant coat and overall health.

 

This great tasting premium fresh nutrition is gently steam-cooked and scientifically formulated to
support a long healthy life. It can be served as a delicious topper or a complete and balanced meal.

 

[Learn More][208]
[woman cutting Hill's Fresh product]
The Benefits
of a science-led diet
For Lean Muscles

We use only high-quality protein sources in our foods since they are the essential building blocks
of all tissues and organs of the body.

For a shiny coat

Fatty acids in many of our food formulas have important roles in immune system functions and help
protect the skin and coat.

For strong bones

 A balanced selection of vitamins and minerals keeps joints lubricated and helps pets build strong
bones and teeth.

ABOUT US

#### Our Responsibility

At Merck Animal Health, we believe our responsibilities to wider society extend beyond our primary
goals as a business. 

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][220]

### Our mission is The Science of Healthier Animals. Our science supports the precious bond between
### people and their pets. It also helps protect international public health, ensure food safety and
### increase protein supplies.

[Learn More][221]
[[icon: arrow-right]][222]

## Our Products

Through our broad portfolio of vaccines, therapeutic medicines, parasiticides, and technology
solutions, we help veterinarians, pet owners, farmers, and producers maintain and improve the health
of animals.

[[icon: arrow-right]Learn more][223]

#### Companion Animal

State-of-the-art products and services that help pets live longer, healthier lives.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][224]

#### Equine

Solutions that help maintain and improve the health and welfare of horses.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][225]

#### Swine

Differentiated health solutions focused on improving swine health and farm sustainability.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][226]

#### Ruminants

Pioneering medicines, vaccines, technology, and insights-driven solutions that aim to improve the
health and well-being of ruminants, enable a sustainable meat and dairy supply, and protect public
health.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][227]

#### Poultry

Innovative products and solutions that make a difference, improving poultry health, welfare, and
productivity.

[[icon: arrow-right] ][228]

#### Aqua

Industry-leading biopharmaceutical and technology solutions that ensure the health, welfare and
sustainability of aquatic species. 

[[icon: arrow-right] ][229]

### Research and Innovation

At Merck Animal Health, our scientists and experts are constantly searching for ways to advance the
state of veterinary medicine and animal health through the discovery and development of innovative
products and solutions, including veterinary medicines, vaccines and technology that improve the
health and well-being of animals.

## **Understanding Heart **
## **Disease in Dogs**

Heart disease in dogs affects heart function and circulation. It can be something a dog is born with
or something they develop over time due to wear, injury, or infection. Even young dogs are at risk.
Regular vet check-ups are crucial for early detection and management.

[ Read More ][20]
Image
[doggy]

#### What are the most common heart diseases in dogs?
* **Myxomatous Mitral Valve Disease (MMVD)**: A progressive condition where the mitral valve, a
  valve that helps control one-way blood flow between chambers of the heart, becomes thickened and
  misshapen, leading to leakage and heart enlargement. It's most common in small breeds, especially
  older Cavalier King Charles Spaniels.
* **Dilated Cardiomyopathy (DCM)**: A disease of the heart muscle where muscle walls thin and the
  chambers become enlarged. It primarily affects large breeds like Dobermans, Boxers, and Great
  Danes.
* **Congenital Heart Defects**: These are present at birth and can include conditions like patent
  ductus arteriosus (PDA), pulmonic stenosis, and aortic stenosis. PDA occurs when blood is
  redirected back to the lungs and can cause fluid build-up and may eventually lead to heart
  failure. Aortic and Pulmonic stenosis are the narrowing of critical heart valves and may cause the
  heart muscle to thicken and eventually lead to heart failure.

#### What breeds are at risk of Heart Failure due to MMVD?

MMVD is the most common type of heart disease in dogs, particularly in small to medium-sized breeds.
Dogs with this type of heart disease develop distorted heart valves, which no longer close properly.
Veterinarians can hear the backward blood flow, referred to as a heart murmur, with a stethoscope.

Predisposed dog breeds:
* Cavalier King Charles Spaniel
* Chihuahua
* Dachshund
* Maltese
* Miniature Poodle
* Miniature Schnauzer
* Shih Tzu

This is not a complete list of at-risk breeds.

#### What breeds are at risk of Heart Failure due to DCM?

DCM is a condition most commonly seen in larger-breed dogs. The heart and the heart muscle of dogs
with DCM is stretched and thinned along with the heart structure, resulting in the heart being
unable to effectively pump blood.

Predisposed dog breeds:
* Cocker Spaniel
* Doberman Pinscher
* Golden Retriever
* Great Dane
* Irish Wolfhound
* Labrador Retriever

This is not a complete list of at-risk breeds

#### What are common signs to look out for?

In the early stages of the disease your dog will show no symptoms and not all dogs will go into
heart failure. Depending on how severe a dog’s congestive heart failure is, symptoms may occur when
a dog is resting, during mild exercise, or during moderate or extreme exertion. If any of these
signs are noted in your dog, contact your vet as soon as possible.

Clinical signs can include:
* Coughing, especially during or after exercise or while resting
* Difficulty breathing or rapid, shallow breathing
* Tiring easily during physical activity or exercise intolerance
* Lethargy or weakness
* Decreased appetite or weight loss
* Abdominal distension or bloating
* Restlessness, pacing, or discomfort
* Fainting or collapse in severe cases

This chart shows how dogs may progress through the stages of MMVD into congestive heart failure,
including when clinical symptoms become visible. It also includes the recommended steps or
treatments for each stage of the disease.

## **Understanding Heart **
## **Disease in Dogs**

Heart disease in dogs affects heart function and circulation. It can be something a dog is born with
or something they develop over time due to wear, injury, or infection. Even young dogs are at risk.
Regular vet check-ups are crucial for early detection and management.

[ Read More ][20]
Image
[doggy]

#### What are the most common heart diseases in dogs?
* **Myxomatous Mitral Valve Disease (MMVD)**: A progressive condition where the mitral valve, a
  valve that helps control one-way blood flow between chambers of the heart, becomes thickened and
  misshapen, leading to leakage and heart enlargement. It's most common in small breeds, especially
  older Cavalier King Charles Spaniels.
* **Dilated Cardiomyopathy (DCM)**: A disease of the heart muscle where muscle walls thin and the
  chambers become enlarged. It primarily affects large breeds like Dobermans, Boxers, and Great
  Danes.
* **Congenital Heart Defects**: These are present at birth and can include conditions like patent
  ductus arteriosus (PDA), pulmonic stenosis, and aortic stenosis. PDA occurs when blood is
  redirected back to the lungs and can cause fluid build-up and may eventually lead to heart
  failure. Aortic and Pulmonic stenosis are the narrowing of critical heart valves and may cause the
  heart muscle to thicken and eventually lead to heart failure.

#### What breeds are at risk of Heart Failure due to MMVD?

MMVD is the most common type of heart disease in dogs, particularly in small to medium-sized breeds.
Dogs with this type of heart disease develop distorted heart valves, which no longer close properly.
Veterinarians can hear the backward blood flow, referred to as a heart murmur, with a stethoscope.

Predisposed dog breeds:
* Cavalier King Charles Spaniel
* Chihuahua
* Dachshund
* Maltese
* Miniature Poodle
* Miniature Schnauzer
* Shih Tzu

This is not a complete list of at-risk breeds.

#### What breeds are at risk of Heart Failure due to DCM?

DCM is a condition most commonly seen in larger-breed dogs. The heart and the heart muscle of dogs
with DCM is stretched and thinned along with the heart structure, resulting in the heart being
unable to effectively pump blood.

Predisposed dog breeds:
* Cocker Spaniel
* Doberman Pinscher
* Golden Retriever
* Great Dane
* Irish Wolfhound
* Labrador Retriever

This is not a complete list of at-risk breeds

#### What are common signs to look out for?

In the early stages of the disease your dog will show no symptoms and not all dogs will go into
heart failure. Depending on how severe a dog’s congestive heart failure is, symptoms may occur when
a dog is resting, during mild exercise, or during moderate or extreme exertion. If any of these
signs are noted in your dog, contact your vet as soon as possible.

Clinical signs can include:
* Coughing, especially during or after exercise or while resting
* Difficulty breathing or rapid, shallow breathing
* Tiring easily during physical activity or exercise intolerance
* Lethargy or weakness
* Decreased appetite or weight loss
* Abdominal distension or bloating
* Restlessness, pacing, or discomfort
* Fainting or collapse in severe cases

# Innovation

Powered by rigorous science and transformative thinking, we're shaping the next frontier of animal
health. From first-to-market therapies to AI-powered diagnostic platforms, our innovations span the
Continuum of Care—predicting, preventing, detecting, and treating disease to meet unmet needs today
while preparing our customers for the challenges of tomorrow.

[Learn More][114]
[A fluffy dog stands on its hind legs greeting a seated colleague while other colleagues watch and
smile near a large window - Zoetis]

# Culture

Our colleagues around the globe are connected through an unwavering commitment to those we serve and
to one another. We've built an award-winning workplace where people feel valued, included,
supported, and proud—living our Core Beliefs every day as we advance animal health and well-being in
over 100 countries.

[Learn More][115]
[Underwater scene with a school of Pangasius fish swimming through clear blue water - Zoetis]

# Sustainability

We are committed to championing a healthier, more sustainable future. One that benefits our
communities, animals and the planet we share. Through our Driven to Care approach, we strive to be
the most sustainable animal health company and create a healthier world for all.

[Learn More][116]
[Group of Zoetis scientists in white lab coats and safety glasses chatting and smiling in a bright
laboratory corridor - Zoetis]

INNOVATORS FOR ANIMALS

# Real Stories, Revolutionary Science

Discover the stories behind our science. Innovators for Animals showcases the veterinarians,
livestock producers, researchers, and purpose-driven colleagues creating life-changing results for
animals and the people who care for them.

[Learn More][117]
Toggle autoplay
[Family in meadow with cattle - Zoetis]

### Welcome to Zoetis

As the world’s leading animal health company, Zoetis is driven by a singular purpose: to nurture our
world and humankind by advancing care for animals. 

With a legacy of nearly 75 years, Zoetis continues to pioneer ways to predict, prevent, detect, and
treat animal illness, supporting veterinarians, livestock producers, and pet owners in over 100
countries.  

We integrate deep scientific expertise, data-driven R&D, advanced manufacturing, and commercial
excellence to deliver meaningful innovation across medicines, vaccines, diagnostics,
biopharmaceuticals, and digital solutions.  

Guided by our vision to be the most trusted and valued animal health company, Zoetis is committed to
setting new standards for the future of animal care through innovation, customer obsession, and
purpose-driven colleagues.

[Veterinarian in a white lab coat gently holding a dairy calf’s face and smiling outdoors in warm
light - Zoetis]

# Purpose

We are a global community of scientists, veterinarians, producers and many others united by our
singular purpose: to nurture our world and humankind by advancing care for animals. Together, we are
helping to shape a healthier future—for animals, for people, for our planet, for all of us. This
commitment defines us as colleagues and as a business.

[Learn More][113]
[Close-up of an automated lab pipetting instrument dispensing into tubes, with a Zoetis researcher
in a lab coat blurred in the background holding a clipboard - Zoetis]

# Innovation

Powered by rigorous science and transformative thinking, we're shaping the next frontier of animal
health. From first-to-market therapies to AI-powered diagnostic platforms, our innovations span the
Continuum of Care—predicting, preventing, detecting, and treating disease to meet unmet needs today
while preparing our customers for the challenges of tomorrow.

[Learn More][114]
[A fluffy dog stands on its hind legs greeting a seated colleague while other colleagues watch and
smile near a large window - Zoetis]

# Culture

Our colleagues around the globe are connected through an unwavering commitment to those we serve and
to one another. We've built an award-winning workplace where people feel valued, included,
supported, and proud—living our Core Beliefs every day as we advance animal health and well-being in
over 100 countries.

[Learn More][115]
[Underwater scene with a school of Pangasius fish swimming through clear blue water - Zoetis]

# Sustainability

We are committed to championing a healthier, more sustainable future. One that benefits our
communities, animals and the planet we share. Through our Driven to Care approach, we strive to be
the most sustainable animal health company and create a healthier world for all.

[Learn More][116]
[Group of Zoetis scientists in white lab coats and safety glasses chatting and smiling in a bright
laboratory corridor - Zoetis]

INNOVATORS FOR ANIMALS

# Real Stories, Revolutionary Science

Discover the stories behind our science. Innovators for Animals showcases the veterinarians,
livestock producers, researchers, and purpose-driven colleagues creating life-changing results for
animals and the people who care for them.

[Learn More][117]
Toggle autoplay
[Family in meadow with cattle - Zoetis]

### Welcome to Zoetis

As the world’s leading animal health company, Zoetis is driven by a singular purpose: to nurture our
world and humankind by advancing care for animals. 

With a legacy of nearly 75 years, Zoetis continues to pioneer ways to predict, prevent, detect, and
treat animal illness, supporting veterinarians, livestock producers, and pet owners in over 100
countries.  

We integrate deep scientific expertise, data-driven R&D, advanced manufacturing, and commercial
excellence to deliver meaningful innovation across medicines, vaccines, diagnostics,
biopharmaceuticals, and digital solutions.  

Guided by our vision to be the most trusted and valued animal health company, Zoetis is committed to
setting new standards for the future of animal care through innovation, customer obsession, and
purpose-driven colleagues.

# More than just animals. More than just technology.

## W Bioceltix wierzymy, że ludzie i zwierzęta są częścią tej samej podróży. Długiej i fascynującej.
## Dlatego obowiązkiem człowieka jest zadbać o ich zdrowie i dobrostan, by dorównać trosce, z jaką
## one dbają o nas, czyniąc wspólny świat pełniejszym.

Jesteśmy biotechnologiczną firmą zbudowaną przez zespół naukowców, którzy dostrzegli potrzebę nowego
spojrzenia na leczenie weterynaryjne.

Z myślą o zwierzętach towarzyszących tworzymy innowacyjne produkty lecznicze, które swoim standardem
nie odbiegają od tych dla ludzi. Rozwijamy pionierskie weterynaryjne leki biologiczne wykorzystujące
immunomodulujące właściwości komórek macierzystych (MSC). Celujemy w choroby o podłożu zapalnym i
autoimmunologicznym, uderzając w przyczynę bólu, nie tylko w objawy.

Opracowana przez nas technologia, w połączeniu z izolowaną linią produkcyjną i farmaceutycznym
standardem jakości, daje nam unikalną przewagę na rodzącym się rynku biotechnologii weterynaryjnej.

Każdego kolejnego dnia jesteśmy bliżej celów, których osiągnięcie zmieni oblicze weterynarii. Naszym
drogowskazem jest nauka, a inspirację czerpiemy z pasji i miłości do czworonożnych przyjaciół.

## Robimy to dla nich

### BCX-CM-J

Produkt leczniczy na bazie allogenicznych komórek macierzystych przeznaczony do leczenia zmian
zwyrodnieniowych stawów u psów.
[ Więcej o leku ][45]

### BCX-CM-AD

Produkt leczniczy na bazie allogenicznych komórek macierzystych przeznaczony do leczenia atopowego
zapalenia skóry u psów.
[ Więcej o leku ][46]

### BCX-EM

Produkt leczniczy na bazie allogenicznych komórek macierzystych przeznaczony do leczenia zapalenia
stawów u koni.
[ Więcej o leku ][47]

### BCX-CM-Sec

Projekt badawczy mający na celu opracowanie bezkomórkowego leku biologicznego skutecznego w
zwalczaniu atopowego zapalenia skóry u psów.
[ Więcej o leku ][48]

### innowacje, które dbają o zdrowie

## BCX w pigułce

Produkty lecznicze zawierające mezenchymalne komórki macierzyste jako aktywny składnik
farmaceutyczny.

Terapia allogeniczna (jeden dawca – wielu biorców).

Immunomudalcyjny charakter komórek oraz potencjał leczenia przyczynowego i objawowego.

Wykazana skuteczność oraz bezpieczeństwo rozwijanych produktów.

Zaawansowany etap rozwoju produktów leczniczych, w tym uruchomiona procedura w Europejskiej Agencji
Leków (EMA).

Wytwórnia komórek macierzystych działająca w farmaceutycznym standardzie jakości cGMP.

# More than just animals. More than just technology.

## W Bioceltix wierzymy, że ludzie i zwierzęta są częścią tej samej podróży. Długiej i fascynującej.
## Dlatego obowiązkiem człowieka jest zadbać o ich zdrowie i dobrostan, by dorównać trosce, z jaką
## one dbają o nas, czyniąc wspólny świat pełniejszym.

Jesteśmy biotechnologiczną firmą zbudowaną przez zespół naukowców, którzy dostrzegli potrzebę nowego
spojrzenia na leczenie weterynaryjne.

Z myślą o zwierzętach towarzyszących tworzymy innowacyjne produkty lecznicze, które swoim standardem
nie odbiegają od tych dla ludzi. Rozwijamy pionierskie weterynaryjne leki biologiczne wykorzystujące
immunomodulujące właściwości komórek macierzystych (MSC). Celujemy w choroby o podłożu zapalnym i
autoimmunologicznym, uderzając w przyczynę bólu, nie tylko w objawy.

Opracowana przez nas technologia, w połączeniu z izolowaną linią produkcyjną i farmaceutycznym
standardem jakości, daje nam unikalną przewagę na rodzącym się rynku biotechnologii weterynaryjnej.

Każdego kolejnego dnia jesteśmy bliżej celów, których osiągnięcie zmieni oblicze weterynarii. Naszym
drogowskazem jest nauka, a inspirację czerpiemy z pasji i miłości do czworonożnych przyjaciół.

## BCX w pigułce

Produkty lecznicze zawierające mezenchymalne komórki macierzyste jako aktywny składnik
farmaceutyczny.

Terapia allogeniczna (jeden dawca – wielu biorców).

Immunomudalcyjny charakter komórek oraz potencjał leczenia przyczynowego i objawowego.

Wykazana skuteczność oraz bezpieczeństwo rozwijanych produktów.

Zaawansowany etap rozwoju produktów leczniczych, w tym uruchomiona procedura w Europejskiej Agencji
Leków (EMA).

Wytwórnia komórek macierzystych działająca w farmaceutycznym standardzie jakości cGMP.

[Read more][81] 25 March 2025 ##### ResearchGate and IntechOpen Announce New Journal Home Partnership As part of our ongoing commitment to expanding the reach and visibility of open access research, we are excited to announce a new partnership with ResearchGate, the leading professional network for researchers. This collaboration will increase the reach and brand visibility of our journals through ResearchGate’s Journal Home platform. [Read more][83] 22 May 2024 ##### IntechOpen Reaches New Milestone: 7,000 Books Open for All IntechOpen has achieved a significant milestone in its mission to democratise scientific knowledge by announcing the publication of its 7,000th open access book, 'Towards the Eradication of* Helicobacter pylori* Infection - Rapid Diagnosis and Precision Treatment.' Guided by the expertise of Dr Liang Wang, Dr Alfred Chin Yen Tay, and 2005 Nobel Prize Laureate Prof. Barry J. Marshall, this book offers insightful research and novel approaches, contributing to the continuous discourse on *Helicobacter pylori*-related research. [Read more][84] 11 March 2024 ##### IntechOpen Signs Open Access Institutional Agreement with Iowa State University IntechOpen signs an institutional agreement with Iowa State University of Science and Technology to support open access and cover open access publishing fees for their faculty. [Read more][85] 07 June 2023 ##### IntechOpen Becomes a UKSG Member IntechOpen is now an official member of the UKSG, the UK's largest scholarly communications community. Founded almost half a century ago, it connects the knowledge community and encourages the exchange of ideas in scholarly communication. [Read more][86] 28 March 2023 ##### IntechOpen Book Wins the 2022 International Academy of Astronautics Life Science Book Award We are thrilled that the International Academy of Astronautics has chosen IntechOpen's book "Preparation of Space Experiments", edited by Dr. Vladimir Pletser, to receive the IAA Life Science Book Award. The award is given annually to recognize excellence in publication by an Academy member or corresponding member in the field of life sciences. ## Baldwin

Animal Dermatology Clinic - Baldwin (formerly Long Green Animal Dermatology Center) is a premier
veterinary dermatology clinic specializing in the diagnosis and treatment of complex skin and ear
conditions in pets. Now part of Animal Dermatology Group (ADG), ADC - Baldwin combines decades of
expertise with the latest advancements in veterinary dermatology to provide highly personalized,
effective care.

At our clinic, we believe in a collaborative approach, working closely with pet owners and referring
veterinarians to ensure the best outcomes for each patient. Our board-certified dermatologists
specialize in managing a wide range of skin and ear issues, including environmental and food
allergies, chronic ear infections, immune-mediated and hormonal skin conditions, and bacterial,
fungal, and parasitic diseases. We utilize state-of-the-art diagnostics and cutting-edge technology
to develop individualized treatment plans aimed at reducing discomfort, improving skin health, and
enhancing pets' overall quality of life.

We understand how profoundly skin conditions and allergies can impact your pet’s well-being. Whether
dealing with chronic itching, dermatitis, ear discomfort, or recurrent skin infections, our
dedicated team is here to make a difference.

Located at [13515 Long Green Pike Baldwin, MD 21013][172], ADC - Baldwin is ready to help your pet
find relief. Contact us today to schedule a consultation and experience the compassionate,
specialized care that sets us apart in veterinary dermatology.

## Baldwin

Animal Dermatology Clinic - Baldwin (formerly Long Green Animal Dermatology Center) is a premier
veterinary dermatology clinic specializing in the diagnosis and treatment of complex skin and ear
conditions in pets. Now part of Animal Dermatology Group (ADG), ADC - Baldwin combines decades of
expertise with the latest advancements in veterinary dermatology to provide highly personalized,
effective care.

At our clinic, we believe in a collaborative approach, working closely with pet owners and referring
veterinarians to ensure the best outcomes for each patient. Our board-certified dermatologists
specialize in managing a wide range of skin and ear issues, including environmental and food
allergies, chronic ear infections, immune-mediated and hormonal skin conditions, and bacterial,
fungal, and parasitic diseases. We utilize state-of-the-art diagnostics and cutting-edge technology
to develop individualized treatment plans aimed at reducing discomfort, improving skin health, and
enhancing pets' overall quality of life.

We understand how profoundly skin conditions and allergies can impact your pet’s well-being. Whether
dealing with chronic itching, dermatitis, ear discomfort, or recurrent skin infections, our
dedicated team is here to make a difference.

Located at [13515 Long Green Pike Baldwin, MD 21013][172], ADC - Baldwin is ready to help your pet
find relief. Contact us today to schedule a consultation and experience the compassionate,
specialized care that sets us apart in veterinary dermatology.

“I couldn’t recommend a better place than MedVet for pet emergencies. Our sweet doodle, Sunny,

grateful for keeping our girl healthy.”

“The expertise, services, and fantastic customer service are outstanding. They treat every person
like family, and their pet interactions are the real winning key. They have an uncanny ability to
ease stressful situations, calm pets, and provide exceptional treatment.”

“I’m so grateful for MedVet’s help with my sweet 5-week-old kitten, Lilo. As a first-time kitten
owner, I didn’t know what to do when she experienced sudden health issues late at night. The staff
were attentive, compassionate, and extremely helpful. I appreciated their thorough communication,
transparency, and love for Lilo—who’s now recovering!”

### State of the art Veterinary Health Care Centre

Niti Bagh Pet Clinic is a well-established, full-service, small animal veterinary practice providing
comprehensive
pet medical, surgical and diagnostic care since 1990.

###### Veterinary OPD

Your pet is an important part of the family, and when they are ill, you want the best available
medical care. We are ready to provide your pet with comprehensive veterinary medical care - from
wellness exams and vaccines to parasite control and nutrition, your pet will receive the highest
quality care.

###### Diagnostics

At Niti Bagh Pet Clinic, we are equipped to provide the most current diagnostic, laboratory and
therapeutic services. We offer on-site x-rays, ultrasounds, electrocardiographs and other
diagnostics to care for your pets' complete health care needs.

###### Vaccinations & Deworming

Pets today can live longer, healthier lives than ever before—in part because of vaccines that help
protect them from deadly infectious diseases. The vets at Niti bagh Pet Clinic will administer the
vaccines and dewormings for your pets.

###### Treatment & Surgeries

We have state-of-the-art surgical facilities including spaying, neutering, mass removal, orthopedic
procedures and more. We utilize the safest available anesthetics to provide that extra margin of
safety, especially for our older or high risk patients.

### Niti Bagh Pet Clinic Veterinarians

The talented pool of Veterinarians, diverse in vet protocols, united in the pet care mission.
Niti Bagh Pet Clinic ensures that animal welfare standards are kept high by enabling veterinarians

  HAPPY 31st BIRTHDAY, OMIA!:
  The short birthday notice (which appeared for just the 26th May) was (secretly) programmed by

  OMIA for several years. Thank you, Matthew! [posted 26th May 2026]
  
  HAPPY DNA DAY!!:
  As many of you will know, today marks the anniversary of the publication of the Watson-Crick paper
  on DNA structure and the "completion" of the Human Genome Project. It is also the third of a
  chronologically symbolic trifecta of days reminding us of major discoveries/achievements: Darwin
  Day (12 February), followed by Mendel Day (6 March), followed by DNA Day (25 April). [posted 25
  April 2026]
  
  [[ All news items ]][22]

# Welcome to OMIA

 

Online Mendelian Inheritance in Animals (**OMIA**) is a catalogue/compendium of inherited disorders,
other (single-locus) traits, and associated genes and variants in 781 (mostly vertebrate) animal
species (other than [human][23] and [mouse][24] and [rats][25] and [zebrafish][26] and [western
clawed frog][27], which have their own resources) co-authored by curator [Associate Professor Imke
Tammen][28] and founder [Professor Frank Nicholas][29] of the [University of Sydney][30], Australia,
with help from [many people][31] over the years. OMIA information is stored in a database that
contains textual information and references, as well as links to relevant [PubMed][32] and
[Gene][33] records at the NCBI, to [OMIM][34], [Ensembl, ][35][Mondo Disease Ontology][36] and the
[Vertebrate Breed Ontology (VBO)][37].

OMIA is manually curated by a [team][38] of specialists. If you see an error or wish to submit an
entry, please [contact us][39].

To join the OMIA Support Group, register at [OMIA Support Group][40].

From 1st September 2011, the OMIA ID is binomial, comprising an OMIA phene ID and the NCBI species
taxonomy ID.

The table below shows summary information for key domesticated species. A more detailed table
covering additional species, as well as information based on phene categories (aligned with
Mammalian Phenotype and Mondo ontology terms), can be found under the [Browse tab][41].

To report a suspected or confirmed inherited disease in Australian animals for surveillance, visit
the Anstee Hub for Inherited Diseases in Animals ([AHIDA][42]).

OMIA has been a free internet resource for over 30 years, with much of the crucial curation work
done on a volunteer basis. Please consider [donating][43] to help pay for maintenance, upgrades and
curation time.

We have recently launched the [Pioneers of Mendelian Inheritance in Animals][44] project (PMIA), an
exploration of the history of research into Mendelian inheritance in animals.

# Welcome to OMIA

 

Online Mendelian Inheritance in Animals (**OMIA**) is a catalogue/compendium of inherited disorders,
other (single-locus) traits, and associated genes and variants in 781 (mostly vertebrate) animal
species (other than [human][23] and [mouse][24] and [rats][25] and [zebrafish][26] and [western
clawed frog][27], which have their own resources) co-authored by curator [Associate Professor Imke
Tammen][28] and founder [Professor Frank Nicholas][29] of the [University of Sydney][30], Australia,
with help from [many people][31] over the years. OMIA information is stored in a database that
contains textual information and references, as well as links to relevant [PubMed][32] and
[Gene][33] records at the NCBI, to [OMIM][34], [Ensembl, ][35][Mondo Disease Ontology][36] and the
[Vertebrate Breed Ontology (VBO)][37].

OMIA is manually curated by a [team][38] of specialists. If you see an error or wish to submit an
entry, please [contact us][39].

To join the OMIA Support Group, register at [OMIA Support Group][40].

From 1st September 2011, the OMIA ID is binomial, comprising an OMIA phene ID and the NCBI species
taxonomy ID.

The table below shows summary information for key domesticated species. A more detailed table
covering additional species, as well as information based on phene categories (aligned with
Mammalian Phenotype and Mondo ontology terms), can be found under the [Browse tab][41].

To report a suspected or confirmed inherited disease in Australian animals for surveillance, visit
the Anstee Hub for Inherited Diseases in Animals ([AHIDA][42]).

OMIA has been a free internet resource for over 30 years, with much of the crucial curation work
done on a volunteer basis. Please consider [donating][43] to help pay for maintenance, upgrades and
curation time.

We have recently launched the [Pioneers of Mendelian Inheritance in Animals][44] project (PMIA), an
exploration of the history of research into Mendelian inheritance in animals.

the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

## Health, safety, and happiness. It’s what every dog and cat deserves.
## It’s why we’re here. We’re glad you found us.

This is your place for information focused on your pet’s health and mental well-being for every
stage of your journey together.

Our team of preventive health and critical care veterinarians, certified trainers, behavior
consultants, and extremely passionate pet lovers are doing all the leg work to provide you with
clear, concise pet care information you can trust.

This is all we focus on: education, advice, and support for you and your pet. Along with our
extensive library of articles, we offer [virtual dog training classes][28] and recommended product
solutions for your pet’s health and behavior needs.

][30]

about pet-safe cleaning product alternatives.

## How to Remove Foxtails From Your Dog & Prevent Injury

Sure, global benchmark Brent crude hit $100 per barrel this week. But good luck doing anything with

sulfur, nitrogen, iron, copper, nickel, and vanadium.

To turn this mess into something useful, you need an oil refinery.

Oil refining separates raw crude into various types of useful products and cleans up all the waste.

Jul 24, 2026 | *Stansberry Digest* | Dan Ferris

**(Almost) nothing runs on crude oil... A million barrels a day gone... The global metabolism...
'The Chicago Way'... Squeamish about messy jobs... The world is leaving us behind...**

## Crude oil is nearly worthless...

Sure, global benchmark Brent crude hit $100 per barrel this week. But good luck doing anything with
it yourself.

As it comes out of the ground, crude oil is a hodgepodge of thousands of hydrocarbon molecules all
mashed together. It's also filled with a bunch of stuff you don't want in your gas tank, like
sulfur, nitrogen, iron, copper, nickel, and vanadium.

To turn this mess into something useful, you need an oil refinery.

Oil refining separates raw crude into various types of useful products and cleans up all the waste.
The resulting products have to meet technical and regulatory specifications before anybody can buy
them.

# I Care about Your Pet's Skin!

Dermatology, encompassing skin, ear, claw & anal sac disease, represents a major element of the
small animal general practice case load. It can be a challenging aspect of clinical companion animal
work. Recurrent skin irritation is especially frustrating & upsetting for the pet, the owner and
veterinary surgeon concerned. Repeated visits to veterinary surgeons can become costly &
time-consuming for chronic cases.

I have seen dermatology cases for over two hundred & fifty separate clinics in the South-East of
England – some centres have referred over three hundred cases to me over the years.

 

## Tailored Animal Dermatology Consultations

I offer extended consultation periods, usually ninety minutes in duration, to encompass a complete
discussion of the patient’s dermatological & general clinical history, including the response to
previous treatments. I will perform various diagnostic tests and explain the possible diagnoses. I
will schedule future diagnostic tests, establish a long term treatment regimen & tailor advice for
each individual patient.

I plan to use medications that have been proven to give good clinical performance, are
well-tolerated by the pet as well as the owner, without controversial ingredients. At the same time,
I will try to limit the practical difficulties with the protocol of use, a convenient formulation, &
practical packaging. I will often recommend topical products that are a pleasure to use considering
their sensory characteristics, application & fragrance. I will try to avoid products with rebound
effects. Better compliance will be established by selecting medications with all of these
characteristics – ease of use, tolerance & performance – in mind. This in turn will benefit the pet
by controlling their condition better.

It is not uncommon that we need to look at establishing a lifelong regimen & it is my goal to put
this plan in your hands by giving you the ability to start, continue & maintain various treatment
strategies that you can adjust at home, throughout the subsequent months & years to come. This
should reduce the number of times you will need to attend your own Vet & this will ultimately reduce
your costs & stress. This will also improve both you & your pet’s quality of life & re-invigorate
the close family bond between you.

A detailed report will be sent promptly to the referring veterinary surgeon after each consultation.
Case progression will be monitored during re-examination & through e-mail & telephone follow-up.

There are continuous advances in veterinary dermatology including improved understanding of
underlying disease processes, recognition of new diseases, advanced diagnostic techniques and
innovative treatments. I endeavour to keep up-to-date with the ever-changing and expanding field of
dermatology around the world, in order to better manage and/or alleviate acute and chronic skin
disease in our pet population.

*I am the only independent, full-time veterinary dermatologist working solely within the South-East.
I have complete clinical freedom from any corporate practice prescribing constraints.
* ### Pro-active
  
  My diagnostic, treatment & management planning will be pro-active.
* ### Evidence-based whenever possible
  
  Whenever possible, I will rely on a scientific, evidence-based approach to your pet’s condition.
* ### Precision Medicine
  
  My service will be tailored for each individual pet & their breed.
* ### Fully explained
  
  I will carefully explain my diagnostic approach & list of possible diagnoses as well as the
  proposed management & treatment plan.
* ### Independent*
  
  The Skin Vet is fully independent & not subject to corporate prescribing constraints.
* ### Cost Effective
  
  Repeated visits to veterinary surgeons become costly & time-consuming for chronic cases, my input
  could dramatically reduce the frequency of these consultations.

# I Care about Your Pet's Skin!

Dermatology, encompassing skin, ear, claw & anal sac disease, represents a major element of the
small animal general practice case load. It can be a challenging aspect of clinical companion animal
work. Recurrent skin irritation is especially frustrating & upsetting for the pet, the owner and
veterinary surgeon concerned. Repeated visits to veterinary surgeons can become costly &
time-consuming for chronic cases.

I have seen dermatology cases for over two hundred & fifty separate clinics in the South-East of
England – some centres have referred over three hundred cases to me over the years.

 

## Tailored Animal Dermatology Consultations

I offer extended consultation periods, usually ninety minutes in duration, to encompass a complete
discussion of the patient’s dermatological & general clinical history, including the response to
previous treatments. I will perform various diagnostic tests and explain the possible diagnoses. I
will schedule future diagnostic tests, establish a long term treatment regimen & tailor advice for
each individual patient.

I plan to use medications that have been proven to give good clinical performance, are
well-tolerated by the pet as well as the owner, without controversial ingredients. At the same time,
I will try to limit the practical difficulties with the protocol of use, a convenient formulation, &
practical packaging. I will often recommend topical products that are a pleasure to use considering
their sensory characteristics, application & fragrance. I will try to avoid products with rebound
effects. Better compliance will be established by selecting medications with all of these
characteristics – ease of use, tolerance & performance – in mind. This in turn will benefit the pet
by controlling their condition better.

It is not uncommon that we need to look at establishing a lifelong regimen & it is my goal to put
this plan in your hands by giving you the ability to start, continue & maintain various treatment
strategies that you can adjust at home, throughout the subsequent months & years to come. This
should reduce the number of times you will need to attend your own Vet & this will ultimately reduce
your costs & stress. This will also improve both you & your pet’s quality of life & re-invigorate
the close family bond between you.

A detailed report will be sent promptly to the referring veterinary surgeon after each consultation.
Case progression will be monitored during re-examination & through e-mail & telephone follow-up.

There are continuous advances in veterinary dermatology including improved understanding of
underlying disease processes, recognition of new diseases, advanced diagnostic techniques and
innovative treatments. I endeavour to keep up-to-date with the ever-changing and expanding field of
dermatology around the world, in order to better manage and/or alleviate acute and chronic skin
disease in our pet population.

*I am the only independent, full-time veterinary dermatologist working solely within the South-East.
I have complete clinical freedom from any corporate practice prescribing constraints.
* ### Pro-active
  
  My diagnostic, treatment & management planning will be pro-active.
* ### Evidence-based whenever possible
  
  Whenever possible, I will rely on a scientific, evidence-based approach to your pet’s condition.
* ### Precision Medicine
  
  My service will be tailored for each individual pet & their breed.
* ### Fully explained
  
  I will carefully explain my diagnostic approach & list of possible diagnoses as well as the
  proposed management & treatment plan.
* ### Independent*
  
  The Skin Vet is fully independent & not subject to corporate prescribing constraints.
* ### Cost Effective
  
  Repeated visits to veterinary surgeons become costly & time-consuming for chronic cases, my input
  could dramatically reduce the frequency of these consultations.

research, data export, and priority support.

Clinical trial data is updated daily from primary registries. Regulatory approval data is updated as
announcements are made. News is aggregated in real-time.

Pushing the limits to advance medicine

Discovery and innovation are our foundation as an academic medical center, making medical
advancements a reality with cutting-edge technology and clinical expertise.

Defining what's possible for a healthier tomorrow

The improved health of our communities is always our focus. With more than 800 physicians across 200
clinical specialties, exciting new medicine is happening here - everyday.

[How to get care][105]
 

# Relentlessly exploring new ways to improve human life.

We’ll do whatever it takes to offer the best in care and empower the best in quality of life. And
it’s an approach that works — whether it’s a patient who undergoes a new, life-saving procedure or a
clinical researcher who finds promise in a new cancer treatment, exciting new medicine is happening
at VCU Health.

# **on the Run**

The trusted online CE platform for veterinary professionals who want real-world, clinically relevant
education — from webinars to podcasts, learn anytime, anywhere.

together through one powerful platform and community. Webinars, podcasts, and videos deliver

matters.

150+ hours of live & interactive RACE-approved CE annually.

24/7 access to our extensive on-demand content library.

[Make CE Simple. Join Now!][19]

Another example of how VETgirl is for every vet professional, whether you’re [**newly retired**][20]
or **[newly graduated][21].**

grows, your whole clinic thrives.

Access CE focused on management, teamwork, and communication.

### VETgirl U Conference

Pack your sunscreen, grab your favorite shades, and get ready to learn, connect, and recharge in the
heart of Scottsdale. VETgirl U 2027 brings together world-class veterinary continuing education,
inspiring speakers, practical takeaways, and an unforgettable resort experience designed for

in veterinary medicine. From sunrise coffee talks to evening networking events, VETgirl U is more
